name: Ongoing Operations & Governance (SDLC Phase 15)
description: Establishing long-term operational excellence — aka SRE & Ops, Continuous Improvement, Risk & Compliance Governance.
owner: SDLC Templates — NoteShare Pro Reference Library

capabilities.name: Ongoing Operations & Governance
capabilities.description: Sustains long-term operational reliability, compliance, and architectural health through recurring governance practices.

checklists.statement: The tech debt register is reviewed and updated on a recurring cadence rather than left stale after creation.
checklists.prompt: Is the tech debt register actively reviewed and updated at each quarterly architecture review?

reviewGates.statement: The ongoing operations and governance practices have been reviewed and accepted as the steady-state operating model for the product.
reviewGates.prompt: Are the SRE, incident management, and governance practices sufficiently mature and sustainable to serve as the steady-state operating model for the product?
